About Everline

A full-service remodeling team — design, permits and build under one roof.

Most remodeling headaches come from hand-offs: a designer who never talks to the builder, a builder waiting on permits, a homeowner stuck in the middle. Everline removes the hand-offs. Our in-house designers, project managers and licensed trades work as one team on your home.

From the first sketch to the final walkthrough, you get one point of contact, a fixed-price contract, and a live schedule you can check any time.

  • In-house design studio & showroom
  • Licensed general contractor (B) & trades
  • Dust-controlled, tidy job sites
  • Daily photo updates in your client portal
  • Transparent, itemized pricing
  • Veteran-owned & operated

FAQ

Questions, answered straight

Most of our kitchen remodels land between $45,000 and $120,000 depending on size, layout changes and finishes. After your free consultation you'll get an itemized, fixed-price quote — try the estimator above for a quick ballpark first.

Typical timelines: bathrooms 4–6 weeks, kitchens 7–10 weeks, whole-home renovations 10–16 weeks. Your contract includes a written schedule, and 98% of our projects finish on it.

Yes — drawings, city submissions, permit fees coordination and every inspection are handled by our team in both Orange County and San Diego. Work never starts until permits are in hand.

Yes. Your consultation includes a photorealistic 3D design and an itemized quote with no obligation. If you sign with us, the same designs become your build plans — nothing is lost or re-charged.

Usually, yes. We seal work areas with dust barriers, run air scrubbers and keep a tidy site. For whole-home projects we'll plan phasing with you — and tell you honestly if a short stay elsewhere makes more sense.

Every project carries a 2-year workmanship warranty in writing, on top of all manufacturer warranties on materials and appliances. If something we built isn't right, we come back and make it right.
